rationale: Mishra 2016 randomized 20 adults across comparisons including 200 g green or gold kiwifruit with cereal. Full Methods and Results measured glycaemia, appetite and satiety. ACTRN12615000222549 is a different study from the kiwi and guar breakfast crossover.

Lubransky 2018 enrolled 30 adults and reports 28 breakfast and 29 lunch completers. SunGold, rice and water preloads preceded congee. The original methods and results cover glycaemia, hormones, satiety and energy intake. ACTRN12616000771459.

Park 2020 studied two green or gold kiwifruit daily with a ground-beef test meal in twelve older adults. The original and corrected figures cover amino acid appearance and metabolism. NCT04356573 public results report the primary and secondary protein metabolism measures.
